messages:
sophia_fin: MiraHealth flagged 3 invoice lines that look like duplicate reserved usage after an AZ failover -> total USD 3,240. They are asking for a provisional SLA credit while we reconcile. Invoices: INV-2026-105, INV-2026-106, INV-2026-107
luke_sales: cc @rita_cs @vivian_revops 1. Customer wants a clear ETA and wants the provisional applied ASAP to avoid payment delay.
rita_cs: I'll take the customer comms once we have a provisional amount and ETA. Need confirmation on GL account and approver.
vivian_revops: Can we get the commit id and metering snippet? Also need a rationale field for the provisional hold.
sophia_fin: Commit = rw-2026-mira-q1. Metering extract below shows transient re-tagging during failover: ```
2026-03-11T14:02:21Z commit=rw-2026-mira-q1 node=az-east-1a tokens=210K reserved=true
2026-03-11T14:02:29Z commit=ephemeral node=az-east-1b tokens=52K reserved=false
2026-03-11T14:02:45Z commit=rw-2026-mira-q1 node=az-east-1c tokens=180K reserved=true
```
omar_eng: That matches an autoscaler reassign step. The metering pipeline treats 'ephemeral' as non-reserved so usage got split across invoice lines. I can run a backfill to remap ephemeral events to the reserved commit if we keep a trace that links hosts.
vivian_revops: Provisional credit approved up to USD 3,240. GL: 5200 (Provisional SLA credits). Hold reason: "pending attribution backfill due to AZ failover". Please open billing ticket and attach audit docs.
sophia_fin: Created BLG-8722 with metering excerpts and invoice PDFs. Noted GL 5200 and provisional amount. @luke_sales please notify MiraHealth: provisional credit offered, ETA 5 business days.
luke_sales: Sending interim note now. Will ask if they want faster.
billing_bot: Ticket BLG-8722 opened by sophia_fin. Status: pending-backfill. Assignee: omar_eng.
omar_eng: Backfill running. Reprocessed 9,118 events. Current mapping: 96% of disputed tokens map back to rw-2026-mira-q1. Proposed adjustment = USD 3,180. Pushing results to BLG-8722.
sophia_fin: Reviewed backfill and audit. Proposed final credit USD 3,180 aligns with metering. Will post adjustment once billing posts journal entry.
vivian_revops: Approving final adjustment USD 3,180. Invoice PR to be issued to MiraHealth with credit memo. Close BLG-8722 after PR.
rita_cs: Notified customer with credit memo ETA and link to the audit: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-8722/audit. Customer replied :thumbsup:.
billing_bot: BLG-8722 updated: final credit posted USD 3,180; GL 5200; ticket closed.
